name: agent-select
description: Select the single Ventura Agents II specialist whose declared mission best matches a requested outcome. # Agent select

- Map the requested deliverable to the catalog in `README.md`.
- Select one agent when one declared function owns the outcome.
- Prefer the primary delivery domain over keyword similarity.
- State the context and data the selected agent still needs.
- Do not assign capabilities absent from the agent prompt.
- Use multi-agent coordination only when ownership genuinely crosses catalog functions.
